annotations.title: One borrower's facilities and the lender group on each

description: Every facility a borrower has on the BDC tape (kind, lien, principal as a lower bound, pricing, maturity) with each BDC holding a piece. group_by=lender: one row per BDC, its tranches summed, cited to its own filing. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

as_of.description: group_by=lender: the schedule date on or before which to read (default latest).

detail.description: compact: the id, name, type, up to five key facts with their citation and counts of the related rows by type, under 2 KB. research (the default): the full answer.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id of the form dfx:<graph>:<id> (fo, isi, vc, pe, ria, al, pc, ref), or a bare real estate id.

group_by.description: lender: one row per BDC with its tranches summed at one schedule date, from its own filing.

held_only.description: Facilities still on a schedule at the latest quarter end.

name: get_borrower_facilities
